title: Tim S Probable NDE 3210
content: I was in a fatal head on collision. Then three weeks later the hospital overdosed me. I went code blue.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No AccidentSurgery-relatedDirect head injury Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) .
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Less consciousness and alertness than normal I don't know.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I can't realy describe it. it's not anything a physical living being would understand
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The out of body experience. It's hard to explain it to someone who has never gone through it.
